title: Scrum Master 4B
description:
Scrum Master**Ready to turn bold ideas into real\-world impact?**  

 At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change, we lead it. AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry\-first accelerator, exemplifies how we scale advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. Whether tackling complex challenges through large\-scale models or agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges.  

  

If you thrive in a fast\-moving, innovation\-driven environment, love building and deploying cutting\-edge AI solutions, and want to push the boundaries of what’s possible, this is your moment.  

  

Genpact (NYSE: G) is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company. We leverage process intelligence and artificial intelligence to deliver measurable outcomes. With a strong partner ecosystem and decades of client trust, we provide innovative solutions that transform how businesses run. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises.  

 Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**


• Collaborating, facilitating, and leading the scrum team to overcome obstacles and realize success throughout the life of each sprint • Organize and facilitates the sprint planning meeting • Facilitates daily stand\-up meetings, demo, and decision\-making processes to ensure quick inspection and proper use of adaptation process • Planning and prioritization of sprints/releases • Conduct scrum ceremonies as per sprint/release cadence \- epic grooming, sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, retrospectives, sprint demonstrations • Sprint tracking, Daily, Weekly, monthly reporting • Compliance and audit to keep a check on the accuracy of inputs on Azure DevBoards • Cross\-team coordination and Issue resolution • Excellent communication and written skills • Flexible to work in any shift and weekends. • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies such as daily standup meetings, sprint planning, sprint review, and sprint retrospective; Coach and mentor team members on Scrum principles and practices; Remove impediments to the team's progress; Work collaboratively with product owners and stakeholders to prioritize and deliver work effectively; Track and report project progress using Agile tools and metrics; Continuously improve team dynamics, processes, and performance.**Qualifications**


Bachelors \- Commerce, Bachelors \- Economics, Bachelors \- Finance, Masters \- Business Administration, Masters \- Business Analytics**Certifications**


Project Management Professional \- Project Management Institute (PMI)Project Management Institute (PMI)**Required Skills**


Agile Methodology, Client Relations, Collaboration Tools, Design Thinking, Executive Presence, Inclusion, Personal Effectiveness, Project Management, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), Storytelling**Language**
